commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+11' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+9' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+8' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+6' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
90+5' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' Substitution. Alex Baena leaves the pitch and is replaced by Eric Bailly (Villarreal).
90+1' The free kick is delivered by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.

87' Having seen unsporting behavior, Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is the recipient.
86' Diego Conde (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

78' Diego Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin (Las Palmas) replacing Stefan Bajcetic.

76' Yeremy Pino comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
74' Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' The attendance is 22909.
72' Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' The rebound finds Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
72' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Diego Conde pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post.
71' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
